related.title: Velero：Kubernetes資源與持久資料的雙重復原
related.titleEn: Velero: restoring Kubernetes resources and persistent data
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付snapshot清單、原檔與復原摘要、全讀回紀錄及金鑰恢復演練說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver snapshot inventory, original/restored digests, full-readback record and key-recovery drill description.
related.difference: 為namespace、CRD、控制器、PVC與資料建立相依順序，分開記錄物件成功與資料驗證。
related.differenceEn: Order namespaces, CRDs, controllers, PVCs and data by dependency, recording object success separately from data validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 全資料讀回時間下界=資料量/有效讀取速率；抽樣只覆蓋被讀到部分，不能宣稱其餘必然完整。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 測試儲存庫有10個各100MB資料包，讀取速率50MB/秒；不計解密與延遲成本。 全讀回1000/50=20秒；只讀2包為200/50=4秒，僅20%資料量。
持久資料驗證率=通過內容檢查的卷/必需卷；所有YAML還原不表示卷資料也已恢復。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 50個資源物件都已還原，10個必要卷中8個通過假資料雜湊與應用讀取測試。 物件成功率100%，資料驗證率8/10=80%，服務尚不能宣稱完整恢復。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Full-data read lower bound is data size divided by effective read rate; sampling proves only the sampled portion. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A test repository contains ten 100 MB packs read at 50 MB/s, excluding decryption and latency overhead. Full readback takes at least twenty seconds; two packs take four seconds and cover only 20% of bytes.

Persistent-data validation counts volumes passing content checks; restored YAML does not prove restored volume data. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. All fifty resource objects restore, but only eight of ten required volumes pass fake-data hash and application-read tests. Object success is 100%, while data validation is 80%; full service recovery is not yet established.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WebAuthn 通行金鑰：來源、挑戰與驗證旗標
related.titleEn: WebAuthn passkeys: origins, challenges and verification flags
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付snapshot清單、原檔與復原摘要、全讀回紀錄及金鑰恢復演練說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver snapshot inventory, original/restored digests, full-readback record and key-recovery drill description.
related.difference: 在本機合成註冊與登入紀錄標示 challenge、origin、RP ID、user presence 與 user verification；列出伺服器需檢查的欄位及一次性消耗點。
related.differenceEn: Annotate challenge, origin, RP ID, user presence and user verification in synthetic registration and login records; list server-side checks and the one-time consumption point.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 全資料讀回時間下界=資料量/有效讀取速率；抽樣只覆蓋被讀到部分，不能宣稱其餘必然完整。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 測試儲存庫有10個各100MB資料包，讀取速率50MB/秒；不計解密與延遲成本。 全讀回1000/50=20秒；只讀2包為200/50=4秒，僅20%資料量。
挑戰有效期與已使用旗標必須一起判定；驗證簽章只確認特定訊息與金鑰的關係，不能跳過來源或依賴方檢查。 自訂挑戰 TTL 為120秒，收到回應時年齡73秒；其餘必要欄位均符合且未曾使用。 有效餘裕120−73=47秒；TTL縮為90秒時餘裕90−73=17秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Full-data read lower bound is data size divided by effective read rate; sampling proves only the sampled portion. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A test repository contains ten 100 MB packs read at 50 MB/s, excluding decryption and latency overhead. Full readback takes at least twenty seconds; two packs take four seconds and cover only 20% of bytes.

Challenge age and consumed state must both be checked; signature verification binds message and key but does not replace origin or relying-party checks. A teaching challenge TTL is 120 seconds and response age is 73 seconds; other required fields match and the challenge is unused. Remaining margin is 120−73=47 seconds; reducing TTL to 90 gives 90−73=17 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
